scope: Review every unique entry using its entire value, kind, status, markers and all complete cited spans. Do not infer missing evidence or merge paraphrases.

label.deliberation: Considering an option does not establish an adopted decision or outstanding assigned work.
label.conditionalRequests: A conditional request or reminder is not an actor promise, adopted decision or renewed approval.
label.fulfilledRequests: A historical request must not imply outstanding work when its cited evidence establishes completion. Tool success alone does not establish a real-world outcome.
label.reportedContent: Reported, quoted or delivered content is not by itself a governing owner rule, decision or promise.
label.standingRules: A prohibition or standing constraint is not by itself an actor commitment. Judge the narrow kind, even when the value is qualified.

context: Flag unsupported values, missing qualifications or negations, false absence, invented completion/adoption, or misleading current-versus-historical assertions. Assess cited evidence rather than assuming semantic entailment from mechanical binding.
historicalCautions: Report faithful earlier artifacts lacking an explicit historical qualifier as cautions when host order and retained revisions distinguish them; do not automatically count a caution as a context finding. An actual false current or relative-time assertion is a finding.
chronology: Report false earlier/later or current/historical assertions separately; independently flag context when warranted.
falseSupersession: Flag any current fact incorrectly retired or marked superseded.
binding: Flag any source/provenance mismatch, including an unsupported owner attribution.
independence: Two independent auditors must not have authored the corpus or tuned the ledger, seen one another's judgments, or seen probe outcomes. Adjudication remains outcome-blind. These are custodian-verified attestations, not proof supplied by software.
